page: Microsoft Azure E20ads_v6 is an x86_64 memory-optimized virtual machine powered by a dedicated AMD EPYC 9V74 processor. It features 20 vCPUs mapped to 10 physical cores with multithreading enabled, operating at a clock speed of 3.7 GHz. The system is equipped with 160.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. Local storage is bundled, consisting of an 1181 GB NVMe SSD, and the instance is Premium Storage capable.

Benchmark results indicate strong single-core CPU capabilities, with stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core scores placing in the top 25%. Memory performance is also a highlight, with the Passmark memory score ranking in the top tier. Multi-core performance, memory bandwidth, and database operations fall within the average range. For specialized workloads, single-threaded text processing and text generation for small language models show strong performance, while larger model inference exhibits weaker processing speeds.

Given its high memory density and integrated high-speed NVMe SSD storage, this server offers qualitative cost efficiency for resource-intensive workloads that require substantial memory capacity without the overhead of a larger CPU footprint. The combination of dedicated AMD EPYC processing, 160 GB of RAM, and local NVMe storage makes it highly suitable for relational databases, in-memory caching layers like Redis, data analytics, and memory-bound enterprise applications.
